chunks: Everything in this book that is from Ṭalḥah ibn Zayd, I have transmitted it from my father and Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with them both—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-Khazzāz and Muḥammad ibn Sinān together, from Ṭalḥah ibn Zayd.

key_terms.جَمِيعًا: together; indicating joint transmission through both named narrators
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct authorial statement of transmission
key_terms.طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ: Ṭalḥah ibn Zayd, the narrator from whom these reports are transmitted
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِي: from my father; part of the stated sanad/isnad route

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from Ṭalḥah ibn Zayd in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad by which the author transmits narrations from Ṭalḥah ibn Zayd in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the transmission route for hadith attribution and verification within Shia hadith literature.
